text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an early summer afternoon bathed in bright sunshine.
Right around when the end-of-day chime sounded, the trainer's office door opened.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~
Do you have a little moment~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who walked in was my trainee, Mejiro Bright.
However, she was supposed to have family business to attend to today—
choice_data_list: Weren't you off from training today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Right now, I am waiting for the car from our estate
to come vroom-vrooming over to pick me up for my errands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So~ would it be alright if I wait here
until it arrives?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
.
Well then... I shall make myself comfortable for a little while~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is completely summer now, isn't it~?
My next day off will surely be perfect amusement park weather.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~ The other day,
Father sent me tickets, you see—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We spend some time chatting about random little things.
The leisurely passing of time is relaxing, but—
choice_data_list: Your ride sure is taking a while...
Your ride sure is taking a while...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is true~... But taking it easy is my specialty.
Let's wait a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but Trainer, isn't today your day to leave early?
Will you be leaving this room soon~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With no practice scheduled, today was indeed a day I could clock out early.
Still, I couldn't just abandon Mejiro Bright by herself.
choice_data_list: It's fine. I'll stay here with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
.
...Fufu, this reminds me of something~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sitting side by side like this, taking it so~ easy.
We did this back in winter as well, didn't we~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...When you are by my side, Trainer...
I feel as though I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Become even more of a relaxed slowpoke
than usual, you know...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding dong... dang dong...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my~?
Goodness, goodness... it is already completely dusk, isn't it~?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, your ride really is late, isn't it?
...Yeah, your ride really is late, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My plans to leave early were long gone.
The clock on the wall was rapidly approaching overtime territory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it is quite unusual for the Mejiro family chauffeur
to be more leisurely than myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let me place a call to check............ Oh my?
The screen is completely dark~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After plugging it into a charger and waiting a moment for it to come back to life,
I checked the smartphone and found several voicemails.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Chauffeur
text_block_list.text:
"Pardon the intrusion, Lady Bright. Regarding today's schedule,
due to unforeseen circumstances, the engagement has been postponed."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Chauffeur
text_block_list.text:
"Accordingly, with our sincere apologies, there will be
no need for you to depart from the academy grounds, so——"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...My, this message is from three whole hours ago.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that I have kept you waiting in vain
for quite a terribly long time as well, Trainer~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reassured her that it allowed me to get a head start on tomorrow's work,
and that since I hadn't stepped in to stop her either, she shouldn't worry. To which——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, then I suppose it is all right, but~...
I do feel as though we were a tad too 'leisurely.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I had a wonderful time
getting to chat with you so much~...
choice_data_list: I had a wonderful time too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, is that so? Then I suppose it turned out well after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Or did it, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the sun had completely dipped below the horizon...
there was no doubt that we had spent a quiet, fulfilling time together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After walking Mejiro Bright—who still wore a slightly puzzled look—back to her dorm,
I called it a day.
